title: docs(changeset): the hono bump note names the streamed-body 500 edge and which clients send a backslash
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMscMg6AKHasj3ZXEDorLPH)_

Refs #33211 (landed as #33225)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 #33225 留下的那个待发布 changeset 里的两句话，不动任何代码。
- 为什么改：review#1 对 #33225 的两条可选意见（PASS 时提出）当时 PR 已进合并队列，没法补进去：一是 node-server 还有一处行为变化（响应流前两次读取出错时，原来发截断的 200，现在是 500 并断开连接），二是“HTTP 库都会把反斜杠变成 /”说得太宽，curl 会原样发送。
- 风险与回滚：只是发布说明文字。回滚 = revert。
- 先看：`.changeset/33211-hono-security-bump.md`。
- 两分钟验证：看本 PR 的 diff，两句话的改动。
- 需要你做的：无，A5 自审落地。

## What changes

**DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of the pending note `.changeset/33211-hono-security-bump.md` (from #33225), before a release consumes it:
1. The `Clause-②:` paragraph now also names the second edge that moves in `@hono/node-server`: a streamed response whose body stream errors within its first two reads was sent as a truncated `200` and is now a `500` (`text/plain`) with the socket closed; of ours, only the raw AI/MCP stream passthrough can meet it.
2. The BREAKING paragraph no longer says every HTTP library rewrites a backslash: browsers and WHATWG-URL clients (`fetch`, undici) do; `curl` sends it as written.

Both are review#1's optional notes on #33225 at head `56fd8aeb`, which could not be folded in because that PR was already in the merge queue. `Check Changeset` stays red by design on this class (route 0: a PR that only corrects a pending note); it is not a required context. No `skip-changeset` label.

## Verification

Text only: one file, 2 lines changed. No code, no test.
